metadata.question: On July 20, 2025 at 10:44 am local time, did the volcanic plume from Halemaʻumaʻu Crater extend more than 5 km (horizontal distance) from the summit of Hawaii’s Kīlauea volcano?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: We need a single (or a short sequence) of satellite images taken within a few minutes of the requested local time (20 July 2025 10:44 HST = 20:44 UTC). – Sensor: high-resolution True/SWIR, only Sentinel-2 (10 m) has daylight acquisitions every ~5 days; Landsat 9 is 30 m and repeats only every 16 days, but check as a fallback. – Collection: COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED, plus COPERNICUS/S2_CLOUD_PROBABILITY to cloud-mask. – Date window: ±1 day to guarantee at least one scene even if acquisition is one orbit earlier/later. – Location: Halemaʻumaʻu vent ≈ –155.287° 19.408°; define a 12 km radius circle so we can measure a plume up to 5 km from summit. 2. Masking strategy: – Question is about a visible/SWIR volcanic plume, not clouds. Mask clouds using s2cloudless (>60 % prob). – Compute SWIR-visible plume by differencing a pre-eruption July median (2024 & 2023 July) for band B11 (2.2 µm). – Positive anomaly (threshold 300 DN) over clear pixels = plume candidates. – Create binary plume layer and find the farthest pixel from summit inside the image. 3. C1 / C2 / C3 logic – C1: if collection size == 0 after date & simple BBox filter. – C2: if the plume layer has 0 pixels (all masked or nothing above threshold). – C3: if maximumDistance result is None/NaN. – Otherwise: if max distance > 5,000 m → A (Yes), else B (No). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # Local 20-Jul-2025 10:44 HST → 20:44 UTC date0 = ee.Date('2025-07-20T20:44:00') s_start = date0.advance(-1, 'day') s_end = date0.advance( 1, 'day') summit = ee.Geometry.Point(-155.287, 19.408) roi = summit.buffer(12000) # 12 km radius # --- 1. Get Sentinel-2 data + cloud prob s2 = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(s_start, s_end) .linkCollection( ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_CLOUD_PROBABILITY'), ['probability'])) n = s2.size().getInfo() if n == 0: print("No 2025-07-20 ±1-day images over Kīlauea.") print("C1") exit() # --- 2. Cloud-mask and build pre-eruption baseline def maskcloud(img): cloud = img.select('probability').gt(60) return img.updateMask(cloud.Not()) baseline = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(roi) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(7,7,'month')) .filterDate('2023-01-01','2024-12-31') .select('B11') .median()) plumeImg = (s2.map(maskcloud) .select('B11') .median() .subtract(baseline) .gt(300)) # bright SWIR anomaly # --- 3. Distance from summit to farthest plume pixel plumePix = plumeImg.selfMask().sample( region=roi, scale=60, geometries=True) if plumePix.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No valid plume pixels after masking.") print("C2") exit() def addDist(f): dist = f.geometry().distance(summit, 1) return f.set('dist', dist) maxDist = plumePix.map(addDist).aggregate_max('dist').getInfo() # --- 4. Result print(f"Images: {n}, Max plume pixel: {maxDist:.0f} m from summit.") print("A" if maxDist>5000 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# Local 20-Jul-2025 10:44 HST  →  20:44 UTC
date0 = ee.Date('2025-07-20T20:44:00')
s_start = date0.advance(-1, 'day')
s_end   = date0.advance( 1, 'day')

summit = ee.Geometry.Point(-155.287, 19.408)
roi = summit.buffer(12000)      # 12 km radius

# --- 1. Get Sentinel-2 data + cloud prob
s2 = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterBounds(roi)
        .filterDate(s_start, s_end)
        .linkCollection(
            ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_CLOUD_PROBABILITY'),
            ['probability']))
n = s2.size().getInfo()
if n == 0:
    print("No 2025-07-20 ±1-day images over Kīlauea.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# --- 2. Cloud-mask and build pre-eruption baseline
def maskcloud(img):
    cloud = img.select('probability').gt(60)
    return img.updateMask(cloud.Not())

baseline = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
              .filterBounds(roi)
              .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(7,7,'month'))
              .filterDate('2023-01-01','2024-12-31')
              .select('B11')
              .median())
plumeImg = (s2.map(maskcloud)
              .select('B11')
              .median()
              .subtract(baseline)
              .gt(300))         # bright SWIR anomaly

# --- 3. Distance from summit to farthest plume pixel
plumePix = plumeImg.selfMask().sample(
    region=roi, scale=60, geometries=True)
if plumePix.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No valid plume pixels after masking.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

def addDist(f):
    dist = f.geometry().distance(summit, 1)
    return f.set('dist', dist)
maxDist = plumePix.map(addDist).aggregate_max('dist').getInfo()

# --- 4. Result
print(f"Images: {n}, Max plume pixel: {maxDist:.0f} m from summit.")
print("<answer>A</answer>" if maxDist>5000 else "<answer>B</answer>")
data.exec_msg:
Images: 2, Max plume pixel: 11959 m from summit.
<answer>A</answer>
